description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPassportType' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format immigration record entity values into document types using a predefined mapping.

classes.name: FormatWithPassportType
classes.description: A formatter class that converts immigration record entity values into document type strings based on a static map.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for the given entity value, matching it to a document type or null if not found.
